status: Independent static source follow-up; not a design choice, runtime test, measured exploit or all3 approval
moduleResolutionLimit: Mammoth declares its browser/unzip.js mapping; no nested Mammoth/jszip installation exists, and root JSZip source was reviewed. No bundler/import execution was performed.

observations.fact: readResume checks file.size<=5MiB before reading. For DOCX it calls mammoth.extractRawText({arrayBuffer}) inside abortable; no AbortSignal, extraction byte limit or deadline is passed to Mammoth.

abortable rejects its own promise and continues observing work.then. It does not invoke a cancellation/termination method on the underlying DOCX work. ProfileDialog also checks controller identity/aborted state before applying results.
observations.limit: Static absence of a cancellation path is not a measurement of post-cancel CPU duration or browser freeze.

observations.fact: ProfileDialog applies content.slice(0,50000) after await readResume. This result/UI length bound does not cap prior ZIP expansion, XML parsing or raw text creation.

Browser Mammoth opens JSZip.loadAsync(arrayBuffer) without limit options and reads entries through async(uint8array). JSZip async accumulates chunks and concatenates full output. Its declared uncompressed-size equality check is at end, not an application budget.
JSZip GenericWorker is an in-library event/stream object; this name does not establish a browser Worker or OS-thread resource boundary. The inspected application DOCX path creates no browser Worker.

requiredFollowUpBeforeProductChange: Use bounded fictional valid DOCX fixtures to measure expansion/cancellation and UI responsiveness, not real resumes or an unbounded stress payload.

Independently design limits for declared and actually expanded bytes, entry count/XML work and wall time; choose budgets from valid-file compatibility and measurements rather than the unrelated Cloudflare128MiB limit.
A disposable browser Worker may provide cancellable execution; it alone does not provide a hard heap ceiling. Compression metadata preflight alone does not prove actual expansion is bounded.
Preserve normal imports, latest-import-wins/cancel behavior, no stale profile/filename writes, private-data network guarantees and recovery through a subsequent normal import.
Whole-source/testing stages and all3 exact-plan consent remain required before patching or claiming validation. No DOCX code/test change in this follow-up.
riskLimit: Exposure inspected here is user-selected local DOCX processing. No remote code execution, server upload, anonymous service attack, resource-exhaustion reproduction, browser crash or final severity is established. JSZip documentation explicitly distinguishes full-result memory use from guaranteed browser freezing.
